usedFor: Cal ID holds booking requests and forms, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers after “Booking Requested”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Requested” in Cal ID, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A booking request is the moment to react, and the action lets your own machine do the work.

watchOut: “Booking Requested” is not “Booking Rescheduled”, so a moved booking will not run the command unless you add that trigger.
